Sandhi error. hatāḥ + asmābhiḥ would give 'hatā asmābhiḥ' (visarga of -āḥ drops before a vowel and the words stay apart, no merging). The printed single token hatāsmābhiḥ (ā + a > ā) can only be hatā + asmābhiḥ, i.e. f. nom. sg. agreeing with pṛthivī (sarvā); the masculine plurals suhṛdaḥ, bāndhavāḥ are carried along by the first subject. Translation is unaffected.

summary: 28 units reviewed (26 verses + 2 speaker lines). All tokens present; sandhi and compounds correct except one: unit 8 'hatāsmābhiḥ' must be hatā (f. nom. sg., agreeing with pṛthivī) + asmābhiḥ, since hatāḥ + asmābhiḥ cannot merge into one token; the gram and note need the same fix (1 error-severity issue, 3 patches). Everything else is minor: small supplied words in translations (units 6, 7, 11, 15), an unidiomatic Hindi passive in unit 9, an imperfect tense choice in Hindi unit 3, atha/vā gloss in unit 17, an optional 'these' in unit 25. The draft's flag on unit 16 (cintayatum -> cintayitum, 'possible') is correct and correctly hedged; metre is neutral. Units 13, 14 and 20 were checked: the medium confidence is honest in each case and the metre supports the printed readings samāsitāḥ and pṛthivīsuhṛdadruhaḥ (no typo). No regrouping suggested. Glossary additions proposed for the maintainer (not written here): svarga = heaven (स्वर्ग); names Duryodhana, Suyodhana, Nārada, Karṇa, Dhṛṣṭadyumna, Sātyaki, Virāṭa, Drupada, Dhṛṣṭaketu, Śikhaṇḍin, Abhimanyu; putra (voc.) = son (पुत्र); kṣatradharma = the dharma of a kṣatriya (क्षत्रिय-धर्म). Counts: error 1 (3 patches), minor 12.
